card.name: Birth-death years of mathematicians
card.fires_on: Digits and punctuation inside a life-span in parentheses, such as (1908-1992), right after the name of a mathematician or logician. Also a name in a maths reference list.

modes.label: Life-span digits
modes.description: Digits in a year range after the name of a mathematician.

modes.label: Punctuation after name
modes.description: A semicolon or closing parenthesis around the dates in a quoted mathematician citation.

card.plain: It fires on birth and death years after the names of famous mathematicians, and it prepares the model to write maths-related words.
